auth.invalid: That email and password did not match.
auth.pendingTitle: Your account is waiting for approval
auth.pendingBody: An admin needs to activate your account and set your role before you can use the CRM.
auth.noAccess: You do not have access to this page.
auth.loadFailedBody: Usually a weak connection or an expired session. Try again; if it keeps happening, sign out and back in.

sale.title: New sale
sale.scanPrompt: Scan a barcode or type a SKU
sale.emptyBasket: Nothing in the basket yet. Scan an item to begin.
sale.insufficient: Not enough stock for {{sku}}. Someone may have just sold the last one.
sale.customerPhoneHint: Optional, but it is what links a customer to their past orders
sale.queuedForPacking: Added to the packing queue, waiting for its confirmation call.

stock.title: Stock
stock.adjustHelp: Use a negative number to take stock out. The change is recorded against your name and cannot be edited afterwards.
stock.empty: No products yet. Import them from Shopify first.

sync.title: Sync issues
sync.empty: The CRM and Shopify agree on everything.
sync.trustCrmHelp: Leaves stock alone and pushes our number to Shopify again.
sync.trustShopifyHelp: Records an adjustment bringing the CRM in line with Shopify.
sync.noSkuDetail: {{count}} variants in Shopify have no SKU, so the CRM cannot track them. Add the SKUs in Shopify - this closes on its own once they arrive.
sync.numbersFrom: Shopify's numbers are from the check at {{when}}. If stock was changed in Shopify after that, press “Check with Shopify now” first.
sync.order_changed_in_shopify: Order changed in Shopify after it shipped
sync.order_sync_failed: Could not update the order in Shopify
sync.orderChangedHelp: Its items changed in Shopify while it was with the courier, so the CRM did not move stock. Check the order and edit it here if needed.
sync.orderEditFailed: The edit is saved in the CRM but has not reached Shopify. It is retried automatically.
sync.orderCancelFailed: The cancellation is recorded in the CRM but has not reached Shopify. It is retried automatically.
sync.orderSent: The order was updated in Shopify.
sync.orderStillFailing: Shopify still refuses. The reason is on the issue.
sync.orderDoneHelp: Closes the issue. Edit the order here if needed.

queue.title: Packing queue
queue.outcomeHelp: Cancelling here saves a courier run out and another one back.
queue.holdUntilHelp: It drops out of this queue until that date.
queue.driverHelp: They hold the cash until they hand it in. The order stays here, under their name, until then.
queue.refusedHint: Customer refused? Check it back in on Returns with the order number.
queue.shipmentNumberNeeded: Enter or scan the courier's shipment number first.
queue.shipmentNumberTaken: That shipment number is already on another parcel. Check the label.
queue.collectedAllHelp: From now they are with the courier. If one was left behind, scan each label the courier takes instead.
queue.collectedDone: Done: {{count}} parcels are with the courier now.

signals.otherNames: This number is also used as {{names}}

returns.title: Returns
returns.scanPrompt: Scan the code on the parcel, or type an order number
returns.emptyInbound: Nothing is on its way back.
returns.notFound: No parcel or order with that code.
returns.notReturnable: There is nothing to check in for {{orderNumber}} right now.
returns.needsFailureHelp: Nobody recorded this failure yet. Pick a reason and it gets recorded and checked in together.
returns.needsPostDeliveryHelp: Pick a reason, then what came back of each piece and what the customer kept. It is recorded and checked in together.
returns.resellableHelp: An opened parcel that just needs repackaging counts as back in stock.
returns.keptHelp: Customer kept: pieces they kept - not counted missing.
returns.shortWarning: This parcel is {{count}} short. It will stay open for someone to chase.
returns.offBill: {{amount}} comes off what the customer owes - they pay only for what they kept.
returns.refundOwed: {{amount}} is owed back to the customer for what came back, shown on the order until it is paid back.
returns.allKept: The customer kept everything - that is a delivery, not a return.
returns.listEmpty: Nothing here matches. Press Enter to look it up anyway.

settlements.title: Courier settlements
settlements.referenceHelp: So a line on your bank statement can be traced back here next year.
settlements.netReceivedHelp: What actually landed in the account, from their notification.
settlements.trackingHelp: Scan it or type it. The amount fills itself in from the order.
settlements.noLines: Nothing entered yet. Work down their statement, one line at a time.
settlements.outOfBalance: This does not balance. Find the missing {{amount}} before signing it off.
settlements.awaitingEmpty: Everything the courier has finished with has been settled.
settlements.awaitingHelp: Parcels the courier has finished with that have not appeared on any statement. Older than their usual cycle means money to chase.
settlements.noProducts: No delivered orders on this statement yet.
settlements.copyManually: Selected — copy it with your keyboard or a long press.
settlements.lineNoteHint: Optional — e.g. they collected a different amount
settlements.pickOpen: Pick from {{count}} parcels not yet settled
settlements.adjustmentIncomplete: Give it a description and an amount that is not zero.
settlements.needsLookHelp: Parcels the courier's statement says one thing about and the CRM another. Open the order and correct whichever is wrong.
settlements.reopenHelp: Its lines can then be corrected or removed. Orders it marked paid stay paid unless their line is removed or changed to a return. It closes again only when it balances.
settlements.reopened_toast: The statement is open for corrections.
settlements.searchLabel: Search by shipment number, order number or customer
settlements.useCode: Add the code {{code}} as it is
settlements.showAdjustment: Charge or credit on the statement
settlements.previewPrepaid: Paid online: they collected nothing. Choose Delivered and enter what they took for shipping as the fee.
settlements.shippingLoss: They charged {{amount}} more for shipping than customers paid.
settlements.shippingProfit: They charged {{amount}} less for shipping than customers paid.

settlementMismatch.not_back: Returned on the statement, not checked in on Returns yet
settlementMismatch.crm_delivered: Returned on the statement, delivered in the CRM
settlementMismatch.crm_returned: Delivered on the statement, returned in the CRM
settlementMismatch.crm_not_delivered: Delivered on the statement, still with the courier in the CRM

orders.title: Orders
orders.searchPlaceholder: Search by order, shipment, phone or name
orders.addItem: Add an item by SKU or name
orders.badPhone: That phone number is not valid.
orders.lockedPaid: This order has been paid for, so its money and contents cannot change. Only the note and the customer details can be corrected.
orders.reopenHelp: Only for a payment recorded by mistake. The order goes back to unpaid with the method you choose, and your reason is saved in its history under your name.
orders.reopenMethod: What the payment method should have been
orders.reopenOnStatement: This order is on a courier statement, so its money was counted against that statement and cannot be reopened.
orders.lockedReturned: This order was returned, so its money and contents are closed. Only the note and the customer details can be corrected.

filter.range: From a date to a date

history.title: Order {{orderNumber}} history
history.itemsEditedShopify: Items changed in Shopify; the CRM followed
history.shopifyShippingRefused: Shopify refused the new shipping fee - change it in Shopify by hand
history.paymentCorrected: Payment status corrected: a Shopify edit had been recorded as a refund
history.shopifyItemsNotShipping: Items updated in Shopify, but it refused the new shipping fee - change that in Shopify by hand
history.returnRefunded: {{amount}} paid back to the customer for the return
history.shopifyClosedAfterReturn: Closed in Shopify after it came back - stock unchanged
history.partialDelivery: Delivered in part: {{kept}} taken, {{back}} coming back

orders.returnRefunded: {{amount}} paid back to the customer for the return.
orders.returnRefundOwed: {{amount}} owed back to the customer for the return
orders.cancelHelp: The items go back into stock.
orders.cancelShopify: It is cancelled in Shopify too, without emailing the customer.

bulk.none: Nothing applies to all of these
bulk.skipped: {{count}} of the selected do not apply and stay as they are.

orders.cancelPickup: Shipment {{tracking}} is booked with the courier: ask them to cancel the pickup.
orders.shipToHelp: Changes this order only, not the customer record or their other orders.
orders.undoDeliveredHelp: For an order marked delivered by mistake. It goes back to the courier or our driver, as it was, and the order history records it under your name. If it really came back, check it in on Returns afterwards.
orders.partialHelp: For each piece, say how many the customer took and how many are coming back with the courier. What comes back is taken off what is owed at once and shows on Returns as coming back; its stock returns when it is checked in there.
orders.partialCustomerPays: The customer pays the courier {{amount}} (what they took, and the shipping)
orders.partialDriverCash: Cash from our driver: {{amount}} (what was taken, and the shipping)
orders.partialRefund: {{amount}} is owed back to the customer - it was paid online
orders.partialDone: Order {{orderNumber}} delivered in part: {{kept}} taken, {{back}} coming back. Check it in on Returns when it arrives.
orders.undoPartialNote: What was marked coming back is cleared with it.

reports.title: Reports and log
reports.truncated: Showing the most recent {{count}} entries. Narrow the dates to see the rest.
reports.refusalCostHelp: A refused parcel pays a full shipping fee and comes back with nothing to show for it. This is money spent on nothing.
reports.noRefusals: No refused parcels in this period.
reports.reliabilityHelp: Who refuses delivery. Useful for deciding who should be asked to pay up front.
reports.cohortsHelp: Measured against the week a parcel was handed over, not the week it came back. A cohort younger than 14 days is still moving and will get worse before it settles.
reports.noUnsettled: Nothing delivered is waiting on its money.

analytics.title: Reports
analytics.netHelp: Ordered, less discounts, less what came back on the day it came back. Cancelled orders never count.

completed.title: Completed sales
completed.help: Orders delivered with their money in: net, orders and pieces, the average, what is not complete yet, and the best sellers.

custom.title: Custom report
custom.help: Choose what it shows - net sales, variants, top sellers, return rate - and keep it by name.

sales.title: Sales over time
sales.help: Day by day: ordered, discounts, returns, net.

products.title: Sales by product
products.help: Best and worst sellers, and how much of each came back.

sizes.title: Sizes & colours
sizes.help: Which sizes and colours sell - what to make more of.

channels.title: Channels & payment
channels.help: Website, shop, social media, and how they paid.

governorates.title: Governorates
governorates.help: Orders and refusal rate in each governorate.

refusals.title: Refusals & returns
refusals.help: Why things come back, what it costs, and who refuses.

courier.title: With the courier now
courier.help: Every parcel out and not yet delivered or back.

owed.title: Owed by the courier
owed.help: Delivered and not on a statement yet.

statements.title: Courier statements
statements.help: What arrived, fees, and the shipping difference.

stock.title: Stock health
stock.help: Sold out, running low, and sitting unsold.

takenOut.title: Pieces taken out
takenOut.help: Photoshoots, gifts, the factory: who has them, since when.

customers.title: Customers
customers.help: New and returning, and who buys most.

analytics.areaHelp: Refusal rate of the orders that finished (delivered or refused).
analytics.unknownAreaNote: {{count}} of {{total}} orders have no governorate recorded and are not counted here.
analytics.refusalFeesHint: From the courier's statements in the period
analytics.whoRefusesHelp: Across every order since the CRM started - to decide who should prepay.
analytics.courierHelp: Days since the courier collected it. Red has been out longer than usual.
analytics.returnsAwaitingHint: Came back, their fee not on a statement yet
analytics.owedHelp: Two weeks and still not on a statement: ask the courier about it.
analytics.shippingDifferenceHint: Shipping customers paid, less what the courier charged

stockHint.out: None left, and it sold in the last 30 days
stockHint.slow: In stock, none sold in 30 days

analytics.stockHelp: At the pace of the last 30 days, after returns. Tap a code for its history.
analytics.takenOutHelp: Everything taken out that has not come back.
analytics.sinceCrm: Since the CRM started - orders before it are not known.
analytics.noCosts: No piece has a cost yet, so the value is zero. Enter costs on the Stock page to see stock value and profit.

custom.name: Report name
custom.includeOpenHelp: Orders placed in the range that have not reached the customer yet: being packed or with the courier. Left out, the numbers cover only what reached the customer or came back.
custom.openNote: {{count}} orders in the range have not reached the customer yet, {{value}} in sales.
custom.openCounted: Counted as sold the day they were ordered, as in every other report.
custom.noOpen: No open orders in the range.
custom.nameTaken: A saved report already has this name.
custom.refusalRate: Refusal rate of finished courier orders

from.courier_by_hand: Marked paid by hand, no statement

money.inHelp: What actually arrived in this period: Accurate’s transfers on the day received, from reviewed statements (after their fees), and every other order on the day it was marked paid, less refunds. Nothing is counted twice.
money.collected: Collected by Accurate, not paid over
money.heldHelp: Right now, whatever the order’s date: what Accurate collected from customers (what they took, and the shipping) that is not on a reviewed statement yet, and what is still out to collect. Accurate takes its fees off when it pays.
money.noneIn: Nothing came in in this period.
money.noneHeld: Nothing is with the couriers now.

custom.refusedPieces: Pieces refused at the door (not sales)

completed.rule: An order is complete once it is delivered and its money is ours: Accurate's statement reviewed, our driver's cash in, or paid in the shop or in advance. Each order is in the period it was placed in, and an exchange stays on the original order, complete once the new piece is. A past period grows as statements come in.
completed.shipping: Shipping the customers paid (not a sale)
completed.waitingHelp: Orders placed in the period not delivered yet, or whose money has not reached us. Values are goods after discounts.

standing.onTheRoad: On the way to the customer

completed.addsUp: {{placed}} orders in the period: {{completed}} complete · {{waiting}} still to come · {{back}} refused or returned
completed.noneWaiting: Every order in the period is complete or came back.
completed.topHelp: By size, in pieces delivered with their money in.
completed.itemsHelp: Each product in its colour, from completed orders only.
completed.copyFailed: Could not copy - download the table instead
completed.noneDone: No completed orders in this period yet.

log.title: Log
log.help: Every piece in or out of stock and every change to an order: when, who, and where the piece went or why.
log.search: Search product, SKU, order number, customer or staff

what.cancellation: Back on the shelf · order cancelled
what.return_manual: Back on the shelf · by hand
what.return_shopify: Back on the shelf · refunded in Shopify
what.shopify_closed_after_return: Closed in Shopify after the return
what.return_refunded: Return paid back to the customer

note.cancelled_before_pickup: Cancelled by the customer before the courier collected it
note.refund_no_money: A Shopify edit recorded as a refund; no money moved

custody.overdueHelp: Delivery takes three to five days and a refusal comes back within two or three. Anything past that needs a phone call.
custody.allTitle: Everything with the courier right now
custody.shortHelp: A counted shortfall recorded at check-in — not a suspicion, a confirmed loss.

staff.title: Staff
staff.addHint: New logins are created in the Supabase dashboard (Authentication → Users). They show up here automatically, inactive, ready to activate.
staff.name: Name
staff.activateAndSetRole: Activate this account and give it a role.
staff.roleInUse: {{count}} staff have this role. Change their role before deleting it.

stockOut.title: Take stock out
stockOut.reasonNeeded: Write why the stock is going out.
stockOut.notEnough: There are not enough of {{sku}} in stock.
stockOut.closeHelp: {{count}} pieces have not come back. They already left stock; this only stops the wait.

inventory.title: Products and stock
inventory.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU or barcode
inventory.wholeNumbers: Enter whole numbers from zero up.
inventory.enterSomething: Enter a quantity for at least one size.
inventory.receiveHelp: Enter how many pieces of each size arrived. They are added to current stock.
inventory.countHelp: Enter the number you actually counted for each size. Only the difference is recorded, worked out when you save so a sale during the count is not lost.

install.title: Install the app
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari
install.iosNote: Open the site in Safari. Duch then appears as an app on the home screen.
install.bannerBody: Opens like an app from the home screen, full screen.

scan.title: Barcode reader
scan.aim: Point the camera at the barcode
scan.denied: The site is not allowed to use the camera. Allow it in the browser settings.
scan.failed: The camera did not start. Try again.

exchange.title: Exchange
exchange.byCourierHelp: The new piece is packed and shipped as a new order, and the courier collects the old one. It goes back into stock when checked in on Returns.
exchange.inStoreHelp: The customer is in the shop: they take the new piece now, and the old one goes back into stock at once.
exchange.searchOther: Another product: search by name or SKU
exchange.damaged: Damaged - does not go back into stock
exchange.feeStillPaid: The customer still pays the courier {{fee}} shipping.
exchange.done: Exchanged: new order {{orderNumber}} - the customer pays {{amount}}.
exchange.doneRefund: Exchanged: new order {{orderNumber}} - {{amount}} owed to the customer.
exchange.checkInNote: An exchanged piece from order {{original}} (replacement {{replacement}}). It goes back into stock; the original order stays as it was.
exchange.doneRefundShop: Exchanged: new order {{orderNumber}} - hand {{amount}} back to the customer now.

reportsPage.rule: Counted here: orders placed in this period, delivered, and paid for. Shipping the customer pays is not counted.

profit.nothingSold: No completed sales in this period yet.
profit.noCostLong: No cost is typed in for this product, so its profit here is overstated. Add it under Costs and spending.
profit.noCostsYet: No cost is typed in for anything sold yet.
profit.noFixed: No expenses recorded in this period.
profit.statementHelp: Top to bottom: each line leads to the next. Tap a line to see what is behind it.
profit.productsHelp: Tap a product for its sizes, colours and what a piece costs. Profit here is after making it, the reserves and its share of the ads.
profit.draftNotice: {{count}} lines on courier statements still in draft ({{amount}}) - not counted until the statement is reviewed.

uncosted.body: {{count}} products sold with no cost typed in ({{names}}) - the profit shown is overstated.

line.salesHint: {{pieces}} pieces in {{orders}} orders - delivered and paid, after discounts
line.lossReserveHint: Set aside per piece - what is left comes back below
line.giftReserveHint: Goes to the gift fund, not profit
line.adsHint: Shared across products by pieces sold
line.lossLeftoverHint: {{reserve}} set aside less {{cost}} the courier cost
line.giftStock: Dead stock bought by the gift fund

courier.none: No courier losses on reviewed statements for this period's orders.

fund.title: Gift fund
fund.help: An amount from every piece gathers here and is spent on offers and gifts. What is not spent rolls over.
fund.fromHelp: Orders placed before this date set nothing aside for the fund.
fund.openingHelp: If the fund already held money before counting started.

waiting.title: Not counted yet
waiting.help: Orders of the same period that are not complete. Once delivered and paid they join the profit above.
waiting.addsUp: {{placed}} orders in the period = {{completed}} complete + {{waiting}} still to come + {{back}} refused or returned.
waiting.none: Every order of the period is complete or came back.

costs.productsHelp: Tap a product to change its cost.
costs.productsMissing: {{count}} products have no cost yet - they are listed first. Tap one to add it.
costs.listLegend: The first figure is what a piece costs to make; under it, what is left of the price after making and reserves (before ads).
costs.editorHelp: Type what one piece costs, line by line. Rename, remove or add lines. An empty line is not counted.
costs.addException: + differs for a size or colour

kindHelp.loss_reserve: Set aside per piece against courier losses. What is not spent returns to profit.
kindHelp.gift_reserve: Goes from every piece to the gift fund.

costs.modeFixHelp: Changes the cost in force since {{date}} for everything sold under it.
costs.modeNew: A new cost from a date
costs.modeNewHelp: What was ordered before that date keeps the old cost.
costs.firstHelp: A product's first cost also counts for everything sold before it.
costs.needLine: Type at least one line with an amount.
costs.badAmount: The amount for {{label}} is not valid.
costs.confirmDelete: Delete the cost in force from {{date}}? Sales will be costed by the one before it.

ads.addHelp: Type what was paid and the days it covered. It is spread evenly over those days.
ads.badDates: The end date is before the start.

expenses.addHelp: Rent, salaries, a shoot, anything paid. It comes off the profit of the month it was paid in and shows on the monthly report.
expenses.confirmCopy: Copy {{count}} expenses from last month into this one at the same amounts?

gift.addHelp: A gift, a video shoot, free shipping for a customer - anything paid from the fund.
gift.fromStockHelp: The fund buys the pieces at the price you type, and they leave stock as a gift.
gift.fromStockLong: Pick the pieces and type what the fund pays for each. They leave stock and count as sold at that price.
gift.takeOut: Take out of stock and record
gift.needPrices: Give every piece a valid quantity and price.
gift.confirmDeleteStock: Delete this entry? The pieces do not return to stock by themselves - put them back from the stock page if you still have them.

monthly.title: Monthly report
monthly.pdfHint: For a PDF: press the button and choose Save as PDF in the print window.
monthly.editHelp: Choose the parts the report shows. The choice is kept for later months. The figures themselves are not edited here.
monthly.addExpense: + Add an expense for this month
monthly.allHidden: Every part of the report is hidden. Press Edit report.
monthly.reserveHelp: Set aside from pieces sold, less what the courier really cost. What is left is in net profit.
monthly.giveaways: Gifts and offers (from the gift fund)

returns.title: Back after delivery
returns.help: Every return or exchange recorded in the period, at what it sold for. Partial means the customer kept the rest of the order.
returns.exchangesHint: the old piece back, another out
returns.valueHint: at the price sold, after discount

refusals.title: Refused at the door
refusals.help: Every parcel that came back undelivered in the period. Partial means the customer took some and refused the rest - which carries no fee.
refusals.rateHint: of {{count}} courier orders finished in the period

courier.moneyTitle: Money with the courier and drivers
courier.moneyHelp: Now, whatever the order's date: collected and not on a reviewed statement, or still out.
courier.none: Nothing is with the courier right now.

money.title: Money that came in
money.help: Each transfer or payment on the day it arrived, less refunds. A courier statement counts once reviewed.
money.none: No money recorded in this period.

production.title: Manufacturing log
production.help: Each time you manufacture: the products made together, what they cost, and photos of the receipts. Saving here changes no product's cost until you agree.
production.none: Nothing in the log yet. Record the first run.
production.firstRun: The first run recorded for these products - nothing to compare with.
production.uploadFailed: Could not upload {{name}}. Images and PDFs only, up to 10 MB.
production.confirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}" and its receipts from the log? The cost of products it was applied to stays as it is.
production.name: Run name
production.nameHint: A name you will know this batch by later.
production.piecesHelp: The number is needed when a total bill is shared over the pieces. It does not go into stock - stock is its own page.
production.saveHelp: After saving you are asked whether to apply this cost to the products, and you can add receipt photos.
production.editHelp: Editing the log changes no product's cost. To carry the change over, press Apply to products again.
production.needPieces: Type how many pieces, so the total bills can be shared over them.
production.applyTitle: Apply the cost to the products?
production.applyBody: "{{name}}": a piece costs {{amount}} to make. Choose the products whose cost changes.
production.reservesKept: The product's reserves ({{amount}}) stay as they are.
production.differsWarning: This product's cost differs for a size or colour. Applying makes it one figure for every size - you can put the difference back under Product costs.
production.fromHelp: What was ordered before this date keeps the old cost.
production.priceUntouched: This changes the cost of making only. The selling price stays as it is in Shopify, and stock does not change.
production.pickToApply: Choose at least one product, or press Not now.
